scholarships.title: COMSTECH Research Fellowships for Women Scientists in Least Developed Countries (LDCs) in the OIC
scholarships.official_source: OIC-COMSTECH (Ministerial Standing Committee on Scientific and Technological Cooperation of the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation)

eligibility: Be a woman scientist or woman engineer
Be a citizen of an OIC least-developed country, or be employed by a research institution in an OIC country
Hold at least an M.S. or equivalent degree for graduate studies, or a Ph.D. for post-graduate studies, or be involved in active research
Be aged 35 or under for graduate studies, or 45 or under for post-graduate studies
Submit through the official COMSTECH application form
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to young women scientists and engineers who are citizens of an OIC least-developed country, or who are employed by a research institution in an OIC country, and who hold at least an M.S. or equivalent for graduate studies or a Ph.D. for post-graduate studies, or who are engaged in active research. Age limits are 35 for graduate studies and 45 for post-graduate studies, with preference for women scientists at the beginning of their research career in OIC least-developed countries.
benefits: Supervision and mentoring of local training
coverage: Supervision and mentoring of local training
requirements: Be applying as a woman scientist, scientist or engineer
Be a national of an OIC least-developed country or employed at an OIC research institution
Meet the degree or active-research requirement
Be within the age limit for your level
documents: Evidence of institutional affiliation or citizenship of an OIC least-developed country
existing.english_requirement: Not stated on the official page, so none is asserted.
application_method: Review the published list of OIC least-developed countries and the CCoE host member list
Complete the official COMSTECH application form
Submit the form to the COMSTECH Secretariat contact for this programme
existing.selection_notes: Research fellowships are awarded by COMSTECH together with the host institutions' Joint Scholarship Committee, based on scientific merit. The page states that an age limit applies for these fellowships but that preference is given to young women scientists at the beginning of their research career from OIC least-developed countries.
existing.best_fit: Women researchers and engineers from OIC least-developed countries - 14 of the 15 named countries are African - who hold an M.S. or PhD (or are actively researching), are aged 35 or under (45 or under for post-doctorals), and can commit six to twelve months to a placement at a centre of excellence.
existing.notes: This is a rolling all-year call, so there is no deadline to miss, but it is not a guaranteed award: selection is by scientific merit. The page itemises airfare, accommodation, subsistence, supervision and mentoring but does not state that tuition or enrolment fees are paid, so tuition_coverage is recorded as false and fully_funded as false. The named OIC least-developed countries are Afghanistan, Benin, Burkina Faso, Chad, Comoros, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Mali, Mozambique, Niger, Sierra Leone, Somalia, The Gambia, Togo, Mauritania and Uganda, of which 14 are African, so the region is recorded as Africa. The awarding body requires one COMSTECH programme application per calendar year, so this cannot be combined with the other COMSTECH fellowships recorded in this shard.
existing.duration: 6 to 12 months, extendable upon recommendation of the host institution
existing.application_period: Open all year on a rolling basis; the page is headed 'Call for the applications 2026' and records Call Status: 'The call is currently open'
existing.deadline_display: No fixed deadline; the awarding body states 'Applications / Nominations are open all around the year'
